extDescription.message: Spots the videos playing on any page and saves them in one click. Never touches DRM-protected content.

captureHint.message: This player doesn't expose a file. Grabby replays the video from the start, muted and sped up, and records it. Don't skip ahead while it runs.

rawNotice.message: Very large stream: saved as-is without conversion.

st_offline.message: Connection lost · trying again in $S$ s

err_expired.message: The video's link expired during the pause. Open the video's page again, then restart the download.

err_no_ranges.message: The server doesn't allow this kind of download.

menuPage.message: Download this page's video with Grabby

quickNoneBody.message: Play the video, then try again.

bulkHint.message: Best quality, two at a time

trimHint.message: Cut at the nearest keyframe: the clip may start a few seconds early.

subsApartHint.message: This format can't hold subtitles: they'll be saved next to the video, as .srt.

err_http_403.message: The site refused access to the video (403).

err_http_404.message: The video is no longer available on the server (404).

err_http_other.message: The server returned an error. Try again in a moment.

err_ffmpeg.message: The file couldn't be assembled. The format may not be supported.

err_protected.message: This video is protected. Grabby doesn't download protected content.

err_too_large.message: Too large to assemble in the browser (over 1.5 GB). Pick a lower quality.

err_capture_failed.message: Nothing was recorded. Start the video, then try again.

err_capture_unavailable.message: This player can't be recorded. Reload the page and try again.

err_unknown.message: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.

protectedBody.message: This video is encrypted by its publisher (DRM). Grabby never bypasses protection.

liveBody.message: This live stream (DASH) can't be recorded. HLS and YouTube live streams can.

restrictedBody.message: The browser doesn't let extensions read this page. Open a regular website to find videos.

emptyBody.message: Start playing the video: Grabby picks it up as soon as it loads.

firstRunBody.message: Only download videos you have the right to keep: your own, free-licensed ones, or with the author's permission.

set_saveAs_hint.message: Opens the save dialog for every download.

set_privacy.message: Grabby doesn't collect any data. Everything stays on your device.

hiddenHint.message: Grabby downloads this video in the background: keep watching as usual. You'll get a message when it's done.

set_notify_hint.message: Shows a notification when a download finishes: click it to open the file, or “Show in folder”.

shrinkHint.message: Grabby shrinks the picture itself, in the browser: much slower than a plain download (several minutes, more for a film). It keeps going in the background.

browserAsksNote.message: It's a browser setting, and it comes before Grabby's.

browserAsksBody.message: Turn off "Ask where to save each file" so Grabby saves directly.

set_template_hint.message: Tick what the name is made of, in this order.

browserAsksTitle.message: Your browser asks where to save

partsJoined.message: Join the parts into one file

stillHint.message: The picture is taken at the chosen time, in full quality.

animationHint.message: 30 seconds at most. GIF plays anywhere; WebP is much lighter.

set_schedule_hint.message: New downloads wait for these times. Those already started carry on to the end.

set_wifi_hint.message: On mobile data, downloads wait for Wi-Fi.

set_rate_hint.message: Leaves room for the rest of the connection. On YouTube, the hidden playback slows down to match.

set_updates_hint.message: Once a day, Grabby asks GitHub whether a newer version is out. Nothing else is sent, nothing installs by itself.

listHint.message: Only the videos already shown: scroll the page to load more. Two at a time, numbered in order.

updateBody.message: Click “Update”: Grabby installs it and restarts.

set_install_hint.message: Grabby downloads the latest version published on GitHub, checks its fingerprint, replaces its files and restarts. The first time, install the helper: double-click “installer-mises-a-jour.cmd” in Grabby's folder.

inst_working.message: Downloading and installing the new version…

inst_done.message: Grabby $P1$ is installed. It is restarting…

inst_uptodate.message: Grabby is already up to date.

inst_busy.message: Downloads are running: wait for them to finish, updating restarts Grabby.

inst_helper_missing.message: The update helper is missing. Open Grabby's folder, double-click “installer-mises-a-jour.cmd” (once), then click “Update” again.

inst_err_bad_digest.message: the file received doesn't match the one published on GitHub. Nothing was changed.

inst_err_no_digest.message: GitHub gives no fingerprint for the file. Nothing was changed.

inst_err_bad_package.message: the file received isn't Grabby. Nothing was changed.

inst_err_not_grabby.message: the helper isn't in Grabby's folder. Run “installer-mises-a-jour.cmd” again from Grabby's folder.

inst_err_bad_source.message: the file doesn't come from Grabby's page on GitHub. Nothing was changed.

inst_err_no_release.message: no published version found on GitHub.

inst_err_permission.message: permission to talk to the helper wasn't given.

inst_err_failed.message: the helper ran into an error. Try again later.

historyRedo.message: Download again: the page opens behind and the download starts by itself

set_normalize.message: Even out the volume of sound files

set_normalize_hint.message: MP3, M4A, Opus, FLAC…: every file at the same loudness. The sound is re-encoded.

set_keys_hint.message: Press $P1$ on a page: its video starts downloading at once.

set_sponsors_hint.message: Parts marked by the SponsorBlock community (sponsors, self-promotion) are cut out of the file. Grabby asks SponsorBlock without saying which video: only the start of a fingerprint shared by thousands of others.

queueMove.message: Drag to change the order (or up and down arrows)

queueMoveLabel.message: Move “$T$” in the queue (up and down arrows)

sheetHint.message: Pictures of the whole video, side by side in one JPEG. Grabby takes the smallest quality: the pictures are small.

thumbHint.message: The video's picture, at its biggest (up to 1280 × 720 on YouTube).

ruleApplied.message: Chosen by your rule for $P1$: you can change them.

aiConsent.message: The AI models are downloaded once from Hugging Face (about $P1$ MB for transcription, $P2$ MB per language pair for translation); then everything happens on your computer: nothing is sent.

app_library_lead.message: Everything Grabby saved: play it here, find it, see how much room it takes.

app_batch_lead.message: Paste page addresses: Grabby opens them two at a time in the background and downloads each one's video.

app_channels_lead.message: New videos of the YouTube channels and playlists you follow are saved on their own, checked every hour.

app_workshop_lead.message: A video or sound from your computer: crop, turn, speed up, fit it in a size, add subtitles or a summary, with a live preview.

app_join_lead.message: Several videos or sounds put end to end in one file, in the order you choose.

app_rules_lead.message: What each site downloads without asking: video or sound, format, quality, subtitles, folder. The most precise site wins.

app_backup_lead.message: Your settings, rules, history and followed channels in one file, for another computer or browser.

backupExportHint.message: A readable JSON file, with no password and no data from any site.

backupImportHint.message: Nothing already here is lost: what's missing is added, and the file's settings replace yours.

backupNotOurs.message: This file isn't a Grabby backup.

backupRead.message: Restored: $P1$ settings, $P2$ rules, $P3$ history entries, $P4$ followed channels.

batchAdded.message: Added: $P1$. They open two at a time.

batchErr_no_video.message: no video found within a minute

batchHint.message: One address per line, or mixed in text: Grabby finds them. Each page opens behind the others, its video is downloaded by the site's rule (else your settings), then the tab closes.

batchNothingNew.message: These addresses are already in the list.

burnLabel.message: Burn the subtitles into the picture

finishLocal.message: The AI works on your computer: nothing is sent. Transcribing takes about as long as the video.

finishSlow.message: The picture is made again in H.264: count about the video's length.

follow_ok.message: Its new videos will be saved on their own (checked every hour). Manage it in the full page.

follow_bad_url.message: This address is neither a YouTube channel nor a playlist.

follow_not_found.message: Its list of videos couldn't be read.

follow_offline.message: YouTube isn't answering: try again later.

follow_too_many.message: 50 followed channels at most: remove one first.

joinCopyHint.message: The files are alike: they'll be copied end to end, losslessly and very fast.

joinEncodeHint.message: The files differ (format or picture size): they'll be made again in H.264, fitted to the first one's picture. It takes longer.

joinPick.message: Choose or drop the videos (or sounds) to join

libFileAccess.message: To play your files here, turn on “Allow access to file URLs” on Grabby's page among the extensions.

liveHint.message: The recording follows the live stream until you click Stop and save (or the time chosen), then the file is made.

openApp.message: Full page: library, lists, channels, workshop

overlayAudioTitle.message: Download only the sound with Grabby

previewInPage.message: Play the part chosen in the page's player

rulesEmpty.message: No rules: every download follows your settings.

set_ai_hint.message: Allows the one-time download of the transcription and translation models (from Hugging Face). Everything then happens on your computer.

set_app_hint.message: Automatic rules, address list, followed channels, workshop, joining and backup.

set_overlay_hint.message: A Grabby button shows when hovering videos (and under YouTube's player) to download them in one click.

translateNeedsText.message: To translate, choose subtitles or the transcription.

watchHint.message: A channel's address (@name, /channel/…), a playlist's, or one of their videos. Videos already out aren't taken: only new ones.

workPick.message: Choose or drop a video or a sound

workSubs.message: Subtitles to burn in or translate (.srt, .vtt) — optional

workTooBig.message: File too big to process in the browser (1.5 GB at most).

burnScript.message: Language: $P1$. The font shipped has no letters for it: these subtitles won't be burned in, but saved as an .srt next to the video.

libEmptyBody.message: Open a page with a video and click Grabby, or let it work for you: a list of addresses, followed channels.

libEmptyBusyTitle.message: Your first files are on their way

libEmptyBusyBody.message: They will show here as soon as they are saved.

watchEmptyBody.message: Paste the address of a YouTube channel or playlist: its next videos will be saved on their own, in the quality chosen.
